title: Building owner's scientist boyfriend told her of a New Mexico crash with bodies

tellings.quote: husband boyfriend at the time in the early 50s told her he was a very prominent scientist that a spaceship crashed in New Mexico and that there were bodies Al I recovered

plain: In the early 1950s, a very prominent scientist told the woman he was seeing that a spaceship had crashed in New Mexico and that bodies had been recovered. The UFO investigator James Fox tells Michels this as he heard it from that woman, by then an unnamed 88-year-old building owner, and a man named Boris Zubov is also named in connection with the account. If true, it would put a senior scientist among those who knew of a crash with bodies.
